fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (site feed) carry title/link-style fields. Upstream JSON-LD is passed through close to verbatim, so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may also appear.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-jsonld+html, S2-feed).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (e.g. not_found, unexpected_shape).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, reconstructed from paragraph tags (both modes).

authorPosition.title: Author position
authorPosition.description: Byline role/title as shown on the article page (article mode only) -- observed as untranslated Russian text (e.g. "Автор") on the English edition; kept as raw passthrough.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher organization name (article mode only) -- the agency's legacy Russian legal name «Inform», as emitted by the site's own JSON-LD, kept as raw passthrough.

thumbnail.title: Thumbnail
thumbnail.description: Lead image URL from the feed's <media:thumbnail> element (latest mode).

pubDate.title: Publish date
pubDate.description: RFC 822 publish timestamp as given by the feed (latest mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
